objective: Generalize core idea discovery, selection and explanation across different positional move types, preserving purpose, reply contrast, delayed realization and price.

constraints.actual_screen_cases: Four distinct positions total, all with twenty-second requests and D11. Existing failures were retried only while fixing their concrete boundary; Be7 was opened exactly once and no fifth position was added.
constraints.validation: Reuse exact owned prior root reports and targeted semantic boundaries; no broad suite or long performance sampling

initial_common_hypotheses: Any legal MoveIntent candidate currently disables MovePurpose discovery even if unsupported; a speculative attack can hide an observed route/support/exchange question.
MovePurpose uses static type order and the first candidate instead of considering an observed functional use across candidates.
Prepared intent admission is limited to non-capturing first actions on the played root; existing functional readers and two-root purpose composition must be reused, not reimplemented for each motif.

source.title: Aagaard, Grandmaster Preparation: Positional Play
source.lesson: A concrete relation can be true without being the important idea. Useful piece improvement, relevant weakness and opponent resources must be connected; exchange changes which apparent weaknesses can actually be used.

findings: First functional contact and first legal destination can displace a later witnessed useful role; selection and composition used different paths.
Root-PV-only discovery discards useful routes present in owned reply surveys. An independent full-reply survey is now allowed to refine the purpose without reusing a forced plan test.
Twenty-second functional response work was rejected by a frontend limit branch that only admitted the old short work shape.
A functional reply added to a selected comparison did not carry its search ownership; the frontend discarded the composed body.
Protection discovery ignored a newly supplied guard against the actually observed first reply.
A route returning to the original square cannot causally assign a later plan to the initial move.
Capture roots could lose both purposes merely because their post-exchange positions converge. The same removed controller and remaining user can instead be a shared purpose.
A quiet declined recapture could have no later capture event, detaching the original loss from its response paragraph. Complete reply pricing now includes that root loss.
Grouping multiple evaded attackers in English but not Korean changes anchor multiplicity and triggers paragraph fallback; both languages now share the same group.
Independent Be7 proves a remaining common gap: the f8 bishop/c5 pawn guard interruption is already in observations but is not connected to the witnessed Qxc5 in basic purpose selection.

assessment: partial; the long-term generalization objective is not achieved
result_summary: Shared discovery now preserves useful routes from owned independent reply surveys, composes them into the actual root comparison, and links captured controllers to a remaining piece's actual later use. Delivery and reply-price gaps were repaired. The independent Be7 still exposes fact-to-purpose selection and transaction-composition failures; this is not release-level generalization.

implementation.change: Collect witnessed functional candidates before selecting a speculative move idea. Reuse only owned unrestricted/full-legal reply surveys for discovery. A forced plan test cannot vote for itself. Rewitness the same original piece/task on a different owned branch, including an actually attacked own target.

Follow the same piece through quiet intermediate posts to useful play and close connected exchanges. Compose observed functional purpose with both actual assessment roots. Reject a route returning to the original square as causal evidence for the first move.

After a root capture, connect an originally controlling piece removed in the initial transaction with a surviving piece's later actual arrival on that square. Preserve other controllers and exact witnesses. Shared access is meaningful even when both roots converge; share the same function without claiming different rook boards transpose.

The issued question, selected comparison and browser use the same owned functional witness. Admit existing twenty-second work shapes under the same scope/identity/depth checks; retain rejection of foreign reports, missing prices and depth 19. No search ceiling increase.

Preserve root purpose while adding reply comparison, omit transient attacks by pieces already exchanged away, include root losses when a recapture is declined, and share grouped escape anchors across languages. A broader late-capture completion/translation problem remains in Be7.

remaining_common_bottlenecks.finding: An observed useful action still does not establish the main strategic idea. Static candidate type/order and early contacts can dominate importance.

Controller removal is connected for a capturing root, while a quiet move interrupting a defender and the later target use are still separate. Be7 already has both the f8-c5 blocked relation and the h6/Qxc5 witness.

Completion of missing capture obligations can append a separate English-only action after a purpose/response account. Be7 Qxe7 shows that price closure and semantic narration still have different boundaries.
Some actual alternatives still have unknown purpose, and finite PV evidence does not generally discover prevention, space or long-term plans. No strategy claim is licensed merely by a legal route.

next_shared_work: Connect a changed opponent guard, the actual target/square use, and the reply that preserves or defeats it as one causal candidate; then select its importance against the actual alternative rather than adding another named motif. Keep the first independent failures as the quality baseline.
